edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom forwards execution to the internal _transfer routine.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to finalize fee logic.
_transfer may call swapTokensForEth when the swap threshold is met.
_transfer triggers sendETHToFee when contract ETH exists.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to perform the balance updates.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after a fee-free transfer.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard routes the team portion to _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard reads and writes _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_takeTeam credits _rOwned of the contract address.
_reflectFee reduces the _rTotal reflection supply.
_reflectFee increases the accumulated _tFeeTotal.
_getValues derives token amount components from _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflection components from _getRValues.
_getValues queries the current rate via _getRate.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal to compute supply values.
tokenFromReflection uses _getRate for the conversion.
balanceOf converts reflection balance through tokenFromReflection.
balanceOf reads the _rOwned mapping of the queried account.
msg.sender becomes the sender of the public transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender in transferFrom allowance updates.
msg.sender becomes the owner argument of approve.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from address.
manualswap authorization depends solely on comparison with _developmentAddress/_marketingAddress derived from caller.
manualsend authorization depends solely on comparison with privileged addresses.
onlyOwner gate on setTrading compares _owner with the caller.
_owner guards setTrading against unauthorized callers.
_owner guards the fee setter setFee.
_owner guards setMinSwapTokensThreshold.
_owner guards toggleSwap.
_owner guards setMaxTxnAmount.
_owner guards setMaxWalletSize.
_owner guards excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees.
_owner guards the blacklist function blockBots.
_owner guards the unblockBot function.
block.timestamp is supplied as the router swap deadline, introducing timestamp dependency.
_transfer uses uniswapV2Router address for comparisons and swap triggering.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys and sells.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount to enforce the transaction limit.
_transfer reads _maxWalletSize to enforce the wallet limit.
_transfer reads _swapTokensAtAmount for the auto-swap threshold.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee application.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist mapping.
_transfer checks inSwap before triggering an automatic swap.
_transfer updates the active _redisFee for the trade direction.
_transfer updates the active _taxFee for the trade direction.
swapTokensForEth performs an external call to the router, a potential reentrancy vector.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
lockTheSwap modifier toggles inSwap around the external swap call.
swapTokensForEth reads the router address for approval and the swap call.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH value transfer.
sendETHToFee reads _marketingAddress as the ETH recipient.
The external router call can re-enter token transfer logic before state is finalized.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen flag.
setFee writes _redisFeeOnBuy.
setFee writes _taxFeeOnBuy.
setFee writes _redisFeeOnSell.
setFee writes _taxFeeOnSell.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes _swapTokensAtAmount.
toggleSwap writes the swapEnabled flag.
setMaxTxnAmount writes _maxTxAmount.
setMaxWalletSize writes _maxWalletSize.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFee entries.
blockBots sets the bots mapping for each supplied address.
unblockBot clears the bots mapping entry.
_reflectFee performs a SafeMath subtraction on _rTotal that can revert on underflow.
_transferStandard performs SafeMath additions on reflection balances that can revert on overflow.
_getTValues multiplies and divides to derive percentage fees, sensitive to arithmetic edge cases.
tokenFromReflection validates and uses the rAmount parameter.
recipient parameter flows into transfer.
amount parameter flows into transfer.
from parameter flows into _transfer.
to parameter flows into _transfer.
tAmount parameter flows into _transferStandard.
the path array is passed to the router swap call.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
contractTokenBalance local drives the swap decision in _transfer.
canSwap local gates the automatic swap in _transfer.
takeFee local determines fee removal in _tokenTransfer.
amount parameter flows into the ETH payout in sendETHToFee.
redisFee parameter is used in fee computation in _getTValues.
taxFee parameter is used in fee computation in _getTValues.
currentRate parameter scales reflection amounts in _getRValues.
tTeam parameter is converted to reflections in _takeTeam.
rFee parameter reduces _rTotal in _reflectFee.
tFee parameter increases _tFeeTotal in _reflectFee.
tTransferAmount local feeds the emitted Transfer event.
rTransferAmount local is credited to the recipient reflection balance.
contractETHBalance local is passed as the amount in sendETHToFee.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is the destination parameter of transfer and has no independent semantics.
amount is the value parameter of transfer and has no independent semantics.
sender is the source parameter of transferFrom.
spender is the approval target parameter of approve.
account is the queried address parameter of balanceOf.
rAmount is the reflection value converted by tokenFromReflection.
from is the source parameter of the core _transfer routine.
to is the destination parameter of the core _transfer routine.
tAmount is the token amount processed by _transferStandard.
tokenAmount is the amount approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth.
amount is the ETH value transferred by sendETHToFee.
maxTxAmount is written into _maxTxAmount by this setter.
maxWalletSize is written into _maxWalletSize by this setter.
swapTokensAtAmount is written into _swapTokensAtAmount by this setter.
_tradingOpen is written into the tradingOpen flag by this setter.
_swapEnabled is written into the swapEnabled flag by this setter.
accounts is iterated to update the fee exclusion mapping.
excluded is the boolean applied to each account in the batch update.
bots_ is iterated to populate the blacklist mapping.
notbot is the address cleared from the blacklist.
redisFee is the percentage used in the internal fee math.
taxFee is the percentage used in the internal fee math.
currentRate scales reflection amounts inside _getRValues.
tTeam is the token team amount converted to reflections.
rFee is subtracted from _rTotal inside _reflectFee.
tFee is accumulated into _tFeeTotal inside _reflectFee.
redisFeeOnBuy is one of the fee values written by setFee.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary local used only for the swap decision in _transfer.
canSwap is a temporary boolean local within _transfer.
takeFee is a temporary boolean local controlling fee removal in _tokenTransfer.
path is a temporary swap routing array built in swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is a temporary local holding the payout amount passed to sendETHToFee.
tTransferAmount is a temporary local consumed when emitting Transfer in _transferStandard.
rTransferAmount is a temporary local credited in _transferStandard.
tFee_local is a temporary local computed inside _getTValues.
tTeam_local is a temporary local returned by _getValues.
currentRate_local is a temporary local returned by _getRate.
rSupply is a temporary local holding the reflection supply.
tSupply is a temporary local holding the token supply.
